title: Keep connected-primary large-diff review packages under publication bound
goal: Repair the concrete regression reproduced by PR #109 External Review Request run 36613231716 attempt 2: the connected-primary large-diff fallback correctly omits the full diff but still renders a 68,208-byte package above the trusted 54,000-byte publication bound because bounded source context and repeated connected notices/evidence are composed too generously. Preserve immutable review identity, exact full-diff byte count/SHA-256, changed files, deterministic Linux evidence, authorship/task binding and mandatory exact-GitHub-candidate inspection, while keeping chatgpt-secondary self-contained/fail-closed semantics unchanged.

baselineEvidence.fullDiffFallback: Connected reviewer slot chatgpt fallback activated because exact diff exceeded 32,000-byte embedded-diff bound.
baselineEvidence.priorAuthority: REVIEW-PACKAGE-BOUND-001 / PR #79 and PR #89 established the connected-primary large-diff exception and bounded multi-round history compaction. This new task is a regression repair, not a redesign.
baselineEvidence.currentProductReview: Primary independently inspected exact PR #109 in GitHub and recorded CHANGES_REQUIRED major F001 (unbounded substring lexical matching). No repair may be dispatched until a valid WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_REVIEW state exists.

scope: Modify only .github/workflows/external-review-request.yml, tests/ExternalReviewProtocol.Tests/test_large_connected_review_package.py, and docs/EXTERNAL_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md only if a normative clarification is strictly required. Prefer workflow + regression only when protocol text already covers the behavior.

Do not change external-review-response.yml, agent-repair.yml, review response schema, reviewer-slot authorization, authorship independence, repair-budget semantics, task authority resolution, candidate publication, provider policy, Windows/TIA workflows, product code, secrets, vendor payload handling or IndustrialMDE.

For reviewerSlot=chatgpt with fullDiffEmbedded=false, eliminate redundant package bulk rather than raising the 54,000-byte publication ceiling. The fallback must remain explicitly non-self-contained and must still instruct the connected reviewer to inspect the exact immutable candidate in GitHub.

Preserve exact immutable request/base/task/task-hash/candidate/review identity, changed-file list, exact full-diff byte count and SHA-256, bounded deterministic Linux evidence and artifact evidence, plus bounded prior-review findings when applicable.

The large-diff connected-primary path may omit or sharply cap candidate source-context because the protocol already requires direct exact-GitHub inspection. It must not imply omitted source was reviewed from the package.
chatgpt-secondary and other package-dependent isolated reviewers remain fail-closed when sufficient self-contained source evidence cannot fit the trusted bounds.

Add a deterministic regression at PR #109 scale that renders the real template with large-diff fallback, approximately 16 KB candidate source context, realistic Linux evidence and no prior findings, and proves final package <=54,000 bytes while retaining mandatory identity/hash/inspection notice.
Add a regression ensuring normal embedded-diff and secondary oversized behavior are unchanged.

requirements: Candidate changed paths are exactly the trusted allowed paths.
PR #109-scale connected-primary fallback renders <=54,000 UTF-8 bytes without increasing the bound.

Fallback package retains request/base/task/task-hash/candidate/reviewer/review-round/risk identity, changed files, full exact diff byte count + SHA-256, deterministic Linux evidence, artifact evidence, and explicit mandatory exact-GitHub inspection instruction.
Fallback package does not duplicate the same connected-primary notice in multiple large sections unnecessarily.
When fullDiffEmbedded=false, omitted candidate source text is clearly marked omitted/non-authoritative; the package does not claim self-contained source review.
Normal <=32,000-byte embedded-diff behavior is byte/semantics compatible except for test-only nondeterministic metadata if any.
Prior review history compaction from PR #89 remains unchanged and current-lineage validation still fails closed.
External review response validation, REVIEW_CHANGES_REQUIRED state publication and bounded repair dispatch are unchanged.
Exact-SHA CI is green; no Windows/TIA execution occurs.
